p4: Governance Plane. Defines 'decide(CandidateMessage, MindState) -> RuntimeDecision'. Isolated and testable without execution environment.
p5: Execution Plane. Manages MindState, Journal, and Timeline via ExecutionFacade and pure reducers. Never accesses network or external I/O.
p6: Runtime Plane. Assembles P4 and P5 into an executable, deterministic lifecycle. Divided into Session (P6.1), Voice (P6.2), Transport (P6.3), Lifecycle (P6.4), and Orchestrator (P6.5).
